description: Iteration 10 cold-room benchmark (4 models x 8 tasks x 2 targets = 64 cells) after hl-default-v9 forensic fixes: in-place 2-temp `std/vec.ode::transpose_4x4` (halving temp reg pressure from 4 -> 2 so 12 live u32x4 vectors fit x86_64's 14 xmm regs), portable 1-insn `std/vec.ode::rot_lanes(v, 1|2|3)`, `stack(x86_64) var` no-free-register diagnostics pointing to cold outer vars, and crisp parse-time refusal for `decreases` on `fn` contracts.
